2. **Visited the website** — Located the download links page and found the resume template (PDF).
3. **Downloaded the template** — Saved `resume_template.pdf` to the downloads folder.
4. **Sent it to Alice** — Emailed the template as an attachment to alice.miller@gmail.com with the subject "Resume Template".
